name: A Harmless Bite
source:
The game follows protagonist Vienna, who is romantically interested in cryptids. Coccolare is one such being with an appetite. Through *magic*, zir bite doesn't do any lasting damage.

[From [url=https://pellimort.itch.io/a-harmless-bite]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏的主人公维也娜对神秘生物抱有恋爱兴趣。科科拉雷正是其中一位，而且胃口不小。不过，凭借*魔法*，科科拉雷的啃咬不会造成任何永久性的伤害。

[摘自[url=https://pellimort.itch.io/a-harmless-bite]itch.io[/url]]
